reasoning: A graph consisting only of vertex‑disjoint cliques of size 3 would require the total number of vertices to be a multiple of 3. Since 10 is not divisible by 3, it is impossible to cover all 10 vertices with such cliques, so no graph satisfying the conditions exists.
